fields.Institution: Arun Jaitley National Institute of Financial Management
fields.Approval / Accreditation: Government autonomous institute; AICTE approval/status programme-specific
fields.Fees — Published:
₹11 lakh entire MBA Finance 2026–28, payable in four equal ₹2.75 lakh instalments.
Numeric fee reference ₹L: 11
fields.Fee Scope: Includes study material, examination/certification, research software, hostel lodging and field visits. Mess, laundry, hostel AC/heater consumption and miscellaneous visit expenses extra.
fields.Accepted Exams: CAT, XAT, CMAT, MAT, GMAT, CUET-PG; 2026–28 brochure requires scores not more than 2 years old.
fields.Eligibility: Recognised minimum-three-year bachelor’s degree, 50% aggregate (45% SC/ST/PwD). 2026–28 brochure sets upper age 30 for private participants; corporate executives require 3 years experience and age≤50. Policy allows final-year provisional applicants.
fields.Selection Process: Regular candidates: entrance score 50%, GD 25%, PI 25% (2026–28 brochure); corporate executives: entrance 50%/PI 50%; eligible government officers: PI route. May 2026 policy allows later notified changes.
fields.Avg CTC — Published: Mean not reported; official median ₹8 lakh available.
fields.Median CTC — Published:
₹8 LPA (official MBA Finance 2024–26 placement report, page 5).
Reported median ₹L: 8
fields.Highest CTC — Published:
₹8.9 LPA (official MBA Finance 2024–26 placement report, page 5).
Reported highest ₹L: 8.9
fields.Placement — Published:
100% of eligible and participating students; 46 placed, 44 companies, 159 opportunities.
Published/calculated rate %: 100
fields.Placement Scope: MBA Finance 2024–26. The denominator is eligible and participating students, not all admitted students.
fields.Top Recruiters: Acuity Analytics, Ameriprise Financial, Gallagher & Mohan, IntraEdge, MCQube, Motilal Oswal, Resurgent India, SBI Mutual Fund, NSE, India INX and MCX-CCL.
fields.Official Role Examples: Analyst; Associate; Assistant Manager; Relationship Manager; Management Trainee; Senior Executive (IFSC); Product Manager; Hedging Analyst.
fields.Programme-Aligned Career Paths: Financial Analyst; Credit/Risk Analyst; Corporate Finance; Treasury; Investment/Relationship Management
fields.Notes: Credential correction: the current official programme is a two-year MBA (Finance), with the degree awarded by JNU—not a PGDM. The 2026-28 official brochure and updated programme page were located; placement statistics remain undisclosed in searchable text. | 2026-10-16 research: Official 2024–26 report recovered and page 5 visually inspected. Median is ₹8 lakh, maximum ₹8.9 lakh. Current full programme fee is ₹11 lakh including hostel lodging. No mean inferred from the median. | Final audit: JNU-awarded two-year residential MBA Finance. Official 2026–28 brochure confirms ₹11 L programme fee including lodging, with mess/laundry and specified consumption extra. Official 2024–26 report verifies median ₹8 L, highest ₹8.9 L and 100% of eligible participating students. Intake capacity remains undisclosed in the recovered brochure.
fields.Current Audit Note: 18 Oct 2026 public-source review. Checked: Current identity/JNU degree, residential mode,₹11 L programme fee/exclusions,50%/45% eligibility and national-test route; 2024–26 median ₹8 L/highest ₹8.9 L. Placement report specifies 46 placed and 100% eligible/participating. Median is not a mean.
